title: Americans to vote in US midterms: Trump's Republicans scramble to stop Democratic wave
summary: Republicans made a final push to avoid a predicted thumping in the US midterm elections, as Democrats seek to win control of Congress. title: CPJ: 'Attacks on journalists almost always precede attacks on other rights to broader population'

As the global death toll among media workers continues to rise, a deeper crisis is emerging: the normalization of harassment, intimidation and violence against journalists and the persistent failure to hold perpetrators accountable. “If killers of journalists are allowed to literally get away with murder, that creates the conditions in which we see more and more of those attacks,” warns Ginsberg.
